purpose: Correct an impossible development gate exposed by V29 and improve policy-only FPR transfer without touching final validation.
source: Official CTU IoT-23 timestamped Zeek conn.log.labeled scenarios
final_validation: locked; no final-validation family may be scored while V30 development is tuned

temporal_protocol.heldout_family_rule: all blocks with heldout-family history or future exposure are excluded from train/calibration/policy
temporal_protocol.event_denominator: evaluable clean-onset events only: event must have at least one eligible fully-benign 8-minute history candidate 30-240 seconds before onset
temporal_protocol.unsupported_event_reporting: events with zero eligible clean-history candidates are reported separately as coverage gaps and are not counted as model false negatives
temporal_protocol.why: V29 revealed some captured onsets have zero eligible 8-minute clean-history candidate, making the old per-family event-recall gate mathematically impossible for at least one development family

feature_policy.reuse: V29 causal topology, churn, fanout, overlap and periodicity representation

model.reuse: V29 balanced HistGradientBoosting future-risk plus benign IsolationForest novelty
model.scenario_calibration: after policy-only fusion selection, derive a global benign threshold and same-scenario benign threshold when policy benign support >=50; otherwise use global threshold

claim_boundary: A pass supports forecasting of evaluable clean-onset development events only. Unsupported events remain explicit coverage gaps. It does not prove prediction of every zero-day attack.
